description: This file is a TypeScript script that analyzes source code to locate specific call expressions related to ingress command calls, particularly focusing on 'agentCommand' functions. It includes functions to parse source files, identify relevant call expressions, and run a guard for these call sites within specified source roots, enforcing certain rules about owner-aware commands.

methods.name: findLegacyAgentCommandCallLines
methods.description: Analyzes a source content string to find call expressions to 'agentCommand' and returns their lines.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that executes the callsite guard to check for ingress call sites using 'agentCommand'.
